summary: 2 Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation techniques for GCP Discovery.
description: Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation techniques for GCP targeting the Discovery tactic. Each script invokes the official Stratus binary using an isolated Morgana correlation ID for Detection Fabric correlation. Prerequisite cloud infrastructure is managed by Stratus warmup. Cleanup is performed via the separate cleanup_command using the same correlation ID.
purpose: Validate GCP Discovery detection rules, SIEM alerts, and SOC workflows in an authorized cloud sandbox.
capabilities: 2 Stratus Red Team techniques for GCP Discovery.
Official Stratus binary execution — no custom attack code.
Morgana Test ID used as Stratus correlation ID for Detection Fabric correlation.
Separate detonate + cleanup lifecycle with state preservation.
use_cases: Validate GCP Discovery detection in an authorized cloud sandbox.
Exercise SIEM, CSPM, cloud-native detection, and SOC workflows with real cloud API activity.
Confirm detection rules fire on real technique execution before incident response exercises.
prerequisites: GCP Application Default Credentials configured (gcloud auth application-default login).
GCP project with appropriate IAM permissions.
Authorized test GCP project — never run against production.
safety_notes: Stratus Red Team is designed for authorized sandbox cloud environments only.
Never execute against production cloud accounts, subscriptions, or clusters.
Some techniques create real cloud resources that incur cost — always run cleanup after detonation.
Warmup may take 1–5 minutes for Terraform-based infrastructure setup.
Cleanup uses the same correlation ID; ensure MORGANA_TEST_ID matches the detonation Test.
author: Datadog / Stratus Red Team

scripts.name: STRATUS - GCP - Read GCE Instance Metadata via the Compute API
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for GCP.

Read GCE Instance Metadata via the Compute API

Reads the metadata of a GCE instance via the Compute Engine API, simulating an attacker who has obtained a service account token and uses it to enumerate running instances and harvest secrets embedded in instance metadata fields such as startup-script. Bootstrap scripts that install software, configure databases, or pull secrets from environment variables are a common source of plaintext credentials in GCP environments. Unlike the instance metadata server (169.254.169.254) which is only reachabl

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.
scripts.command:
# Stratus Red Team — Read GCE Instance Metadata via the Compute API
# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_gcp_project}" ]; then export GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT="#{stratus_gcp_project}"; fi

# Select Stratus binary for this Agent OS
if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
  chmod +x "$STRATUS_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=gcp.discovery.download-instance-metadata"
echo "[INFO] Correlation ID: $STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID"

# Warmup + Detonate
"$STRATUS_BIN" detonate gcp.discovery.download-instance-metadata
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "[INFO] Detonation complete: exit=$EXIT_CODE technique=gcp.discovery.download-instance-metadata"
# Emit structured result
echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"stratus-red-team\",\"technique_id\":\"gcp.discovery.download-instance-metadata\",\"correlation_id\":\"$STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID\",\"exit_code\":$EXIT_CODE}"
exit $EXIT_CODE
scripts.cleanup_command:
# Stratus Red Team cleanup — uses SAME correlation ID as detonation
# MORGANA_TEST_ID must match the value used during detonate
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-manual}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
fi

"$STRATUS_BIN" cleanup gcp.discovery.download-instance-metadata
CLEANUP_EXIT=$?
echo "[INFO] Cleanup complete: exit=$CLEANUP_EXIT technique=gcp.discovery.download-instance-metadata"
exit $CLEANUP_EXIT

source_metadata.detection: Identify unexpected reads of instance metadata via the Compute API by monitoring for compute.instances.get and compute.instances.list events in GCP Data Access audit logs originating from identities that do not normally perform Compute Engine management operations.

scripts.name: STRATUS - GCP - Enumerate Permissions of a GCP Service Account
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for GCP.

Enumerate Permissions of a GCP Service Account

Enumerates permissions of a GCP service account by calling projects.testIamPermissions on a large number of permissions. This simulates an attacker who has compromised a service account key and is enumerating what the service account has access to. Warm-up: - Create a GCP service account - Grant a low-value permission set: Storage Object Viewer - Create a service account key Detonation: - Call projects.testIamPermissions, with chunks of 100 permissions each time References: - https://securitylab
